title: Anenji 4200 Protocol 1 owner write clarification
summary: The owner reports successful HA writes and LCD/register-322 readback for AGM/Flooded/User/Li2/Li4/LiB with a patch explicitly declaring FC06. The disconnected-battery test also showed program 39 AdS -> AEN -> AdS after the patch's 425/FC06 action with Flooded and EQ enabled. This confirms reported command acceptance, not a completed equalization cycle or maintainer testing. Program 46 LCD selection endpoints 0/OFF and 500 A were observed; rejection of 501 A was not tested or requested. The proposed voltage/SOC formulas and attached original manual have not yet been independently verified, so no new voltage bounds or dynamic validators are derived from them.
